# The Evolution of Flight Performance

This script evaluates and analyses flight performance data over 10 generations of selection.

### Load packages and data

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(cowplot)
library(patchwork)
library(effectsize)
library(gt)
library(modelsummary)
library(officer)

FP_flight_raw <- read_excel("../../../Raw_data/Data - Selection Flight.xlsx")

CON_flight_raw <- read_excel("../../../Raw_data/Data - Controls Selection Flight.xlsx")
```

### Join and wrangle data

The following data is removed:

FP: those runs which have C0 as NA, and the run which was marked to be voided.

CON: the CON4 G6 run #2 which was mistakenly marked run 1, and noted to have a limited number of flies.

```{r}
# G13 of CON = G10 of FP; change Gen to GenSel
# replace generations of CON with generations of FP selection

CON_flight <- CON_flight_raw %>% 
  mutate(GenFP = parse_number(Generation) - 3) %>% 
  filter(!str_detect(Notes, "limited") | is.na(Notes)) %>% 
  dplyr::select(-Week, -Notes) %>% 
  separate_wider_delim(cols = Line,
                       delim = "-",
                       names = c("Selection", "Replicate"),
                       cols_remove = TRUE
                       ) %>% 
  mutate(Selection = str_replace_all(
  Selection, "Control", "CON")) %>% 
  mutate(Run = as.character(Run))
  
# filtering out NA in C0 and voided data
FP_flight <- FP_flight_raw %>% 
  mutate(GenFP = parse_number(Generation)) %>% 
  filter((!str_detect(Notes, "void") | is.na(Notes)), !is.na(C0)) %>% dplyr::select(-Notes) %>% 
  separate_wider_regex(
    cols = Line,
    patterns = c("Selection" = ".*", "Replicate" = "\\d$")) 


FlightGen_data_wide <- bind_rows(CON_flight, FP_flight)

FlightGen_data <- FlightGen_data_wide %>% 
  mutate(PopRepNest = paste0(Selection, Replicate)) %>% pivot_longer(
  cols = starts_with("C"),
  names_to = "Chamber",
  values_to = "FlyCount"
) %>% dplyr::select(-Month, -Day, -Year) %>% 
  mutate(across(c(Selection, Replicate, GenFP, PopRepNest), 
          as.factor))  %>% 
  group_by(Selection, PopRepNest, GenFP, Run) %>% 
mutate(FlyFreq = FlyCount/sum(FlyCount), RSum = sum(FlyCount)) %>%
  ungroup()

# ensures that runs don't appear duplicate by mistake
Run_summary <- FlightGen_data %>% dplyr::count(
  Selection, PopRepNest, GenFP, Run, name = "N_Rows"
)

unique(Run_summary$N_Rows) # Should only be 32
sumtest <- FlightGen_data$Sum == FlightGen_data$RSum # Should be all true
unique(sumtest)

# Calculate mean distance traversed per factor combination (averaging over Runs)
FlightGen_means <- FlightGen_data %>%
  mutate(ChamberNum = parse_number(Chamber)) %>% 
  group_by(Selection, Replicate, PopRepNest, GenFP) %>% 
  summarise(MeanCh = weighted.mean(ChamberNum, FlyFreq))
```

### Analyses of flight performance

```{r}
# with selection and generation as factors
selgenmod <- lmer(data = FlightGen_means,
                  formula = MeanCh ~ Selection * GenFP + (1|PopRepNest))

a_selgen <- anova(selgenmod)
e_selgen <- eta_squared(selgenmod)
c_selgen <- cohens_f(selgenmod)
o_selgen <- omega_squared(selgenmod)

# Only CON
CONGen_data <- FlightGen_means %>% filter(Selection == "CON") 

CONmod <- lmer(data = CONGen_data, formula = MeanCh ~ GenFP + (1|PopRepNest))

a_CON <- anova(CONmod)
e_CON <- eta_squared(CONmod)

# Only FP
FPGen_data <- FlightGen_means %>% filter(Selection == "FP") 

FPmod <- lmer(data = FPGen_data, formula = MeanCh ~ GenFP + (1|PopRepNest))

a_FP <- anova(FPmod)
e_FP <- eta_squared(FPmod)

# Save ANOVA tables and eta-squared tables in a list
fltevol_tables <- list(
  a_selgen = tidy(a_selgen),
  e_selgen = e_selgen,
  a_CON = tidy(a_CON),
  e_CON = e_CON,
  a_FP = tidy(a_FP),
  e_FP = e_FP
)
```

## Plots

### Mean Plots

```{r}
selgen_segments <- FlightGen_means %>% 
  group_by(Selection, GenFP) %>% 
  summarise(mSelGen = mean(MeanCh), .groups = "drop") %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = Selection, values_from = mSelGen) %>% 
  mutate(selmin = pmin(CON, FP), selmax = pmax(CON, FP))


mean_flightgen_plot <- ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = FlightGen_means, aes(x = GenFP, y = MeanCh, 
  color = Selection, shape =  Replicate), size = 2, alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_segment(data = selgen_segments, aes(
    x = GenFP, xend = GenFP, y = selmin, yend = selmax),
  color = 'gray30', linewidth = 0.3, alpha = 0.8) +
  stat_summary(data = FlightGen_means, aes(
    x = GenFP, y = MeanCh, color = Selection),
    fun = mean, size = 4, shape = '-') +
  scale_color_manual(name = "Selection",
    values = c("CON" = 'steelblue', "FP" = 'firebrick')) +
  scale_shape_manual(name = "Replicate",
    values = c("1" = 15, "2" = 16, "3" = 17, "4" = 18)) +
  labs(x = "Generation", y = "Mean Chamber Traversed") +
  theme_cowplot()

print(mean_flightgen_plot)

```

### Jitter plots in bounding boxes (number of flies in each chamber)

Sample 2500 flies from each treatment combination and plot within chamber boxes.

```{r}
Flight_data_box <- FlightGen_data %>% 
  mutate(ChamberNum = parse_number(Chamber)) %>% mutate(Ch_end = ChamberNum + 1) 

Flight_box_coords <- Flight_data_box %>% mutate(
  x_axis = as.numeric(GenFP),
  n_Sel = nlevels(Selection),
  x_center = x_axis + (as.numeric(Selection) - (n_Sel + 1)/2) * 0.38,
  xmin = x_center - 0.16,
  xmax = x_center + 0.16)

Fly_box_counts <- Flight_box_coords %>% 
  group_by(Selection, GenFP, x_center) %>% summarise(TotCount = sum(round(FlyCount)))

# all flies
Flight_box_indflies <- Flight_box_coords %>% 
  uncount(round(FlyCount)) %>% 
  # Makes individual row for each fly 
  mutate(y_pos = runif(n(), min = ChamberNum, max = Ch_end))

# 2500 randomly sampled flies
set.seed(092799)

Flight_box_ind_sample <- Flight_box_coords %>% 
  uncount(round(FlyCount)) %>% 
  # Makes individual row for each fly 
  mutate(y_pos = runif(n(), min = ChamberNum, max = Ch_end)) %>% 
  group_by(Selection, GenFP) %>% 
  slice_sample(n = 2500, replace = FALSE) %>% ungroup()

Fly_box_samplecounts <- Flight_box_ind_sample %>% 
  group_by(Selection, GenFP, x_center) %>% 
  summarise(TotCount = n())

# 2500 randomly sampled flies
flight_evol_scatter_sample <- ggplot() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = 'grey') +
  geom_jitter(data = Flight_box_ind_sample, 
  aes(x = x_center, y = y_pos, color = Selection, 
      alpha = ChamberNum, size = ChamberNum),
              width = 0.11, height = 0) +
  # boxes for each condition
  geom_rect(data = Flight_box_coords, aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = ChamberNum, ymax = Ch_end), color = 'black', fill = 'white', linewidth = 0.4, alpha = 0.01) +
  
  geom_text(data = Fly_box_counts, aes(
  x = x_center, y = 32 + 0.2, 
  label = paste0("2500/", "\n", TotCount), 
  color = Selection), 
  size = 2.5, vjust = 0, hjust = 0.5, show.legend = FALSE) +
  
  scale_color_manual(name = "Selection",
    values = c("CON" = 'steelblue', "FP" = 'firebrick')) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(0.2, 1.5), guide = 'none') +
  scale_alpha_continuous(range = c(0.05, 0.95), guide = 'none') +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq_along(levels(Flight_data_box$GenFP)),
                     labels = levels(Flight_data_box$GenFP)) +
  lims(y = c(0, 33.5)) +
  labs(x = "Generation", y = "Chamber of flight tunnel", 
  color = 'Selection', 
  title = "Flight tunnel traversal by flies",
  subtitle = "2500 flies randomly sampled from each treatment") +
  theme_cowplot()

print(flight_evol_scatter_sample)


# All flies sampled
flight_evol_scatter_all <- ggplot() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = 'grey') +
  geom_jitter(data = Flight_box_indflies, 
  aes(x = x_center, y = y_pos, color = Selection, 
      alpha = ChamberNum, size = ChamberNum),
              width = 0.11, height = 0) +
  # boxes for each condition
  geom_rect(data = Flight_box_coords, aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = ChamberNum, ymax = Ch_end), color = 'black', fill = 'white', linewidth = 0.4, alpha = 0.01) +
  
  geom_text(data = Fly_box_counts, aes(
  x = x_center, y = 32 + 0.2, 
  label = paste0(TotCount), 
  color = Selection), angle = 45, 
  size = 3.5, vjust = 0, hjust = 0, show.legend = FALSE) +
  
  scale_color_manual(name = "Selection",
    values = c("CON" = 'steelblue', "FP" = 'firebrick')) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(0.2, 1.5), guide = 'none') +
  scale_alpha_continuous(range = c(0.05, 0.95), guide = 'none') +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq_along(levels(Flight_data_box$GenFP)),
                     labels = levels(Flight_data_box$GenFP)) +
  lims(y = c(0, 33.5)) +
  labs(x = "Generation", y = "Chamber of flight tunnel", 
       color = 'Selection', 
       title = "Flight tunnel traversal by flies",
       subtitle = "All flies sampled from each treatment") +
  theme_cowplot()

print(flight_evol_scatter_all)
```

#### Assemble figure with patchwork and save tables

```{r}
flight_evol_fig<-flight_evol_scatter_sample/mean_flightgen_plot +
  plot_annotation(
  title = "Evolution of flight performance",
  tag_levels = 'A')

ggsave(flight_evol_fig, 
       filename = "../../Plots/flight_evol_fig.jpeg", 
       dpi = 400, width = 12, height = 12)
```

Save scatter plot of all flies

```{r}
ggsave(flight_evol_scatter_all, filename = "../../Plots/flight_evol_scatter_all.jpeg", dpi = 400, width = 10, height =10)
```

Tables

```{r}

saveRDS(fltevol_tables, "../../Tables/fltevol_tables.RDS")
```
